rules.reason: Cancellation reason must be either 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'.

rules.policy_clause: For a delivered order, each item can be exchanged to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
rules.reason: The list of items to exchange and the list of replacement items must match one-to-one.
rules.source_section: Retail agent policy > Exchange delivered order

rules.policy_clause: An order can only be returned if its status is 'delivered', and you should check its status before taking the action.
rules.reason: This order is not in 'delivered' status, so it cannot be returned.

rules.policy_clause: An order can only be cancelled if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action.
rules.reason: Only orders with status 'pending' can be cancelled.
rules.source_section: Retail agent policy > Cancel pending order

rules.policy_clause: The user can only choose a single payment method different from the original payment method.
rules.reason: The new payment method must be different from the original and must be a payment method saved on the user's profile.
rules.source_section: Retail agent policy > Modify pending order > Modify payment

rules.policy_clause: At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code.
rules.reason: You must authenticate the user by locating their user id (via email or name+zip) before taking any other action.
